kind: scope-adjusting authorization for the developer-tooling stage
recorded_in: _agent/ani-governance-tx7do-plan/T03-T15-master-goal.md, section 「### T13 补充授权：接管在用最命令的本地 gow，不接管完整通用脚手架」 and the scope pointer added to goals/T13.md
decision_verbatim: 请从当前T13现场继续。本指令明确调整T13工具范围，优先于原总goal/子goal中要求完整照搬gow且不允许裁剪的冲突表述。把本授权写入_agent/ani-governance-tx7do-plan/T03-T15-master-goal.md，并同步T13任务与migration回执；不要只改文档后停止。
scope_now: gow run admin / gow ent admin / gow api (+ version) only, built as the same-named binary from an ordinary directory of the main module
supersedes: the requirement in goals/T13.md to take over the whole general scaffold (all 94 modules of gow's own go.mod, including the gorm.io family)
key_boundaries_kept: no nested go.mod, no permanent replace, no external tx7do install or fallback
non-tx7do versions stay exactly as T00 selected and as already accepted; the tool uses the main module's newer Ent/Atlas/x-tools instead of being blocked on its own older pins
no GORM family may enter the graph
cutting is limited to command registration and the unused dependency subtrees; deleting a feature test of a retained command is not authorized
un-taken sources stay in the locked zip and are recorded NOT_IN_SELECTED_TOOL_SCOPE instead of being shipped behind a build tag
explicitly_authorized_tool_side_effects: remove the automatic go mod tidy from run.Run, build.Run, ent.RunGenerate and buf.RunGenerate (not a global fake success)
buf entry must fail explicitly instead of go install @latest or automatic buf dep update
api must run only the approved active template list, skip the parked buf.model.gen.yaml and never resurrect the parked model entry
local AGENTS.md / README / docs / Makefile / dev-installer changes to point at the local build; protoc must not enter a production runtime layer
acceptance_minimum: build the binary into a task-private bin, check Module.Main, go version -m, and that the tool graph holds no tx7do and no GORM
help is not proof: run ent admin and api in an isolated copy with the same pinned tools, compare trees, check idempotency and that go.mod/go.sum are not auto-written
run admin verified against a minimal test service with bounded shutdown, touching only that child process
an official repeatable entry for the protoc integration cases (tools_integration tag), failing rather than skipping when the tools are absent
final_statement_required: 在用命令已本地接管；未接管完整通用脚手架 — the program must not claim full gow equivalence
